latest.title: Quilt decompositions of surfaces and Torelli group action on the extended Hatcher complex
latest.abstract: We give a presentation of a groupoid of transformations of quilt decompositions of a surface, which are pants decompositions of the surface with the addition of "seams". We consider colored quilt decompositions of a surface, where one side of a quilt decomposition is colored. We also give a presentation of a groupoid of transformations of colored quilt decompositions of a surface. These presentations of such groupoids are realized by constructing connected and simply-connected two-dimensional cell complexes whose 0-cell are these up-to-isotopy structures on the surface. In the latter part of this paper, we show that Torelli group (or more precisely, a torsion-free subgroup of a mapping class group of a surface) acts on these complexes freely.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 为带“缝线”的曲面裤分解及其着色版本建立变换群胚的表示，并构造连通、单连通的二维胞腔复形；进一步证明 Torelli 群的一个无挠子群在这些复形上自由作用。
latest.breakthrough: 把 Hatcher 型复形扩展到更细的 quilt 数据，并把 Torelli 群作用转化为可计算的自由胞腔作用，为研究其群论性质提供新模型。
latest.limitations: 结论聚焦特定分解复形和无挠子群；对整个 Torelli 群的几何或同调后果仍需进一步提取。
latest.priorityReason: 对低维拓扑与映射类群具有直接价值，构造可复用，但与曲率和度量极限的主线关联较弱。
